verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm the CLI covers the daily loop: create/delete/list databases and branches (docs-41), open a secure MySQL/Postgres shell (docs-24), non-interactive SQL execution (docs-17), and server-side Insights/query inspection via CLI (docs-18, docs-26, docs-30), matching create/connect/shell/inspect without the dashboard. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer accounts specifically praising CLI daily-loop usage (community evidence focuses on Metal/migration/pricing, not CLI workflow) and no explicit CLI 'connect' subcommand distinct from shell is named.
